4.text: Mint Condition: The condition of the coin is essential.
Coins are graded on a scale from Poor (P) to Mint State (MS).
A coin in Mint State (MS) 66 or higher commands a premium.
A coin in Poor (P) condition will be significantly less valuable.
Rarity: Low mintages directly translate to higher rarity and, therefore, higher value.
